title: Topic row (Firestore collection `topics`, one document per topic, document id = slug)
description: Counters hold COUNTED posts only: verified human accounts at least 7 days old; steward and AI posts never count. Status changes come from tools/topic_status.py. Nothing is ever deleted: a topic that goes quiet or rests changes status only.

slug.description: 3-48 chars; also checked against the reserved list by tools/topic_slug.py

status.description: eligible = met the active rule, waiting on its wave approval (noindex); only active is indexable

activatedAt.description: set when the topic (re)enters active; drives the doorway 302 -> 301 switch after 60 days

approvedWave.description: approval record, part 1: the wave this topic was approved in; valid only while that wave is listed in topics/approved_waves.json

approvedBy.description: approval record, part 2: the approver (an internal role or id, never published)

approvedAt.description: approval record, part 3: when the wave was approved

stewardOnly.description: true while members cannot post (archived = read-only, hold = not open); stewards only

govNonAffiliation.description: optional; true on a topic reached by a doorway named after a government agency: the topic page shows brand.nonAffiliationGov under the title and in the footer

legalProfile.description: optional; drives the not-advice and 21+ lines on the topic page
